products.title: Omega-3 Joint Support
products.shortDescription: Omega-3 nutrition for senior dogs who still look forward to their walks. EPA and DHA help support healthy joint function.

content.heading: Their first strides
content.text: Watch your dog’s first few steps on a familiar path, especially after a long nap.

content.heading: Standing comfortably
content.text: At a pause in the walk, notice whether your dog rests one paw or shifts weight to one side.

content.heading: Keeping their usual pace
content.text: Let your dog set the pace on a short, level walk. Notice when they slow down or stop.

content.heading: How to use it
content.text: The softgel is designed to be given with a regular meal. Use the serving on the final label for your dog’s weight.

products.title: Gut Support
products.shortDescription: A fiber meal topper for senior dogs. Soluble fiber helps stool hold water and keeps it formed, so changes are easier to notice on the next walk.

content.heading: One familiar meal
content.text: Keep the food your dog already tolerates as the base for their meal.

content.heading: A change you can see
content.text: A formed stool that is easy to pick up is a useful sign to track on their next walk.

content.heading: One change at a time
content.text: Keep treats and table scraps consistent while introducing a new source of fiber.

content.heading: How to use it
content.text: Mix the powder evenly into your dog’s usual food. Use the final label for the portion and keep fresh water available.

products.title: Skin & Coat Support
products.shortDescription: A fatty acid meal topper for skin and coat care. Linoleic acid helps the skin hold moisture beneath the fur you brush every day.

content.heading: During a brush
content.text: Part the fur behind the ears and along the back. Look for flakes close to the skin.

content.heading: After a bath
content.text: Once their coat is dry, feel for coarse patches in places your dog usually enjoys being stroked.

content.heading: Between grooming days
content.text: Compare the same patch of fur each week. Texture is easier to judge in one familiar spot.

content.heading: How to use it
content.text: Drizzle the oil over a regular meal and mix it through. Count any other oils your dog already eats when following the final label.
